i.norm: Prepare a 6-byte local file data buffer. The flags byte sits at index 1 (the parse offset). Setting it to MODIFY_TIME_BIT signals that a modify timestamp is present.
Parse starting at offset 1 with a declared length of 22. The flags byte at localFileData[1] has bit0 set, so modifyTime is read from the remaining bytes and bit0_modifyTimePresent becomes true.
